scope: Proposition 11.32 (Maximality of an unequal ordered tensor factor) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 106. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let S be a high-rank classical simple group on V , and let an ordered proper matrix tensor factor give natural dimensions x < y, both sufficiently large. In isometry type assume that the factor is selfadjoint. In characteristic two assume that the bilateral factor forms are alternating, and in orthogonal type use the canonical tensor quadratic form. Exclude symplectic type in characteristic two. Then the full stabilizer in S of the ordered factor is maximal.
